cohort: 37 pregnancies in 25 women with traumatic SCI
finding: Mothers with SCI experienced a high rate of complications during pregnancy (pyelonephritis, UTI, pressure sores), but infant outcomes were generally good, suggesting that pregnancy in SCI women requires careful management and a multidisciplinary approach.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were performed in 68% of deliveries due to concerns about syringomyelia deterioration, stress urinary incontinence aggravation, or obstetrical reasons.
